instruction: A candid full-body photograph shows two dancers in a studio with a dark wall and wooden floor. On the right, the clean-shaven man in the rust-brown shirt (R3) stands facing left, embracing his partner with a neutral, focused expression. On the left, the woman with a dark ponytail (R4) stands facing right, her back to the camera as she wraps her arms around his shoulders. Both wear black sweatpants and are barefoot, holding each other in a close, standing embrace. Soft, natural studio lighting illuminates the scene, casting subtle shadows on the floor.
